optimizedDescription.value: Translates PHP into deterministic symbols, scoped calls, Composer resolution, framework imports, and hierarchy evidence.

optimizedContext.value:
# php-language-adapter

## Rules

### Analysis
- `PhpLanguageAdapter` handles `.php` as `php`; parses content once with registered Tree-sitter/ast-grep grammar; returns complete `FileAnalysisDraft` plus compact serializable Pass 2 state.
- Never execute PHP/autoload project code or persist AST nodes. Loader rules/parser keepalive stay indexing-session scoped.

### Declarations and identity
- Extract functions, classes, interfaces, traits, enums, methods, properties, top-level constants, class constants, enum cases. Map properties/class constants/enum cases to `SymbolKind.Property`.
- Preserve namespace separately from simple name; retain distinct supported symbol spaces/member forms.
- Use full construct range, exact declared-name half-open `selectionRange`, verbatim attached preceding comments. Omit declarations lacking authoritative ranges.
- Top-level identity uses namespace-qualified module surface. Member owner = syntactically declaring class/interface/trait/enum logical identity; set `parentId` to container symbol ID.
- Derive owners from parser containment before member IDs. Never use raw parser IDs or optional `SymbolNode.parentId` as canonical owner. Omit methods with unproven owner.
- Keep same-name members distinct across owners, including same-line declarations. Preserve static/instance, constructor, property, contract-form evidence when syntax projection supports it. Preserve case; do not guess case-insensitive lookup/magic properties.

### Namespaces and Composer
- Class-like `use X as Y` creates namespace-scoped local binding to canonical target; never public export/hierarchy edge.
- Package identity = nearest bounded Composer `name`. Resolve qualified names using precomputed PSR-4 mappings, longest prefix, indexed-file lookup; cache compact Pass 2 metadata.
- `resolutionManifests()` returns exactly `["composer.json"]`.
- Composer classmap/files, runtime autoloader mutation, ambiguous case-sensitive filesystem alternatives remain unsupported.

### Dependencies, bindings, calls
- Extract literal `require`/`require_once`/`include`/`include_once`; drop variable/concatenated expressions unless deterministic registered rule proves path.
- Preserve registry-based static framework loaders: CakePHP, CodeIgniter, Yii, Laravel, Symfony, Zend, equivalent configured class-literal/loader patterns.
- Loader facts emit `IMPORTS` and receiver bindings only for proven literal/indexed targets. Constructed/loaded aliases and method-local assignments may emit `CALLS` only in proven lexical scope; never leak aliases across methods.
- Emit deterministic facts for namespace aliases, callable scopes, typed parameters/returns/properties, `new`, `$this`, `self`, `static`, `parent`, explicit aliases, supported framework bindings.
- Emit `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` only for proven targets. Caller = innermost enclosing function/method.
- Drop runtime service IDs, arbitrary container lookups, variable loader arguments, unrelated same-shaped calls, reflection, variable class names, dynamic properties, container values, interprocedural aliases.

### Hierarchy and public surface
- Extract class/interface `extends`, class `implements`, trait composition when PHP semantics preserved. Emit `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` only with proven logical owners/member forms.
- Reference facts preserve logical owners, relation/composition kind, source ordering, ordered provenance. Resolver reaches owner then queries member; reached owner is not requested member. Cycles terminate deterministically.
- Trait aliases/`insteadof` affect identity/precedence only when fully modeled; otherwise conflict/adaptation lookup stays ambiguous/unresolved. Never confuse namespace `use` with trait use.
- Namespace declarations expose namespace-qualified logical surfaces; namespace aliases never module-style public re-exports.
- Advertise `hierarchy: true` only while required hierarchy/provenance facts exist; `buildContext: false` while runtime/classmap/files/conditional autoload remain unsupported.
- Represent parse failures, partial framework resolution, unsupported semantics through shared coverage; identical input/context yields deterministic output.

## Constraints
- No PHP execution, framework container instantiation, Composer autoloader invocation, runtime service inference, reflection, variable-class inference, or speculative trait precedence.
- PHP-specific namespace, loader, ownership, trait semantics remain inside adapter.
